blocks.text: Lead compounds mein tabdeeliyan ki jati hain taa ke un ka asar barhe, zehreela pan (toxicity) kam ho aur un ki dawa jaisi khasiyatein (drug-like properties) behtar hon.

blocks.prompt: Drug discovery ka pehla qadam kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Target identification: bimari mein shamil woh molecule (jaise protein ya enzyme) dhoondna jis par dawa asar kar sake.

items: Chaar marhale: target identification, target validation, lead compound identification, lead optimization.
